about_the_game:
In the distant future, humanity drifts through space, searching for a new home. As Detective Darren, you’ve made a living solving the dirty secrets of the wealthy—but this case is different. A renowned scientist has slaughtered his colleagues aboard a research station and locked away all critical data. The fate of the Enceladus Project now rests in your hands. To uncover the truth, you must use a unique technique to enter his mind—a twisted and dangerous world where the boundaries of reality blur. This first-person platformer-puzzle investigation will challenge your perception, where every decision matters, and the truth may be far darker than you ever imagined.

  • Immersive Investigation: Enter the mind of a criminal to uncover hidden truths.

  • Surreal Worlds: Explore dreamlike environments where reality bends and twists.

  • Mind-Bending Puzzles: Solve intricate puzzles using a unique perception-based mechanic.

  • Sci-Fi Mystery: Unravel a gripping narrative set in the depths of space.

  • Atmospheric Soundtrack: Haunting music enhances the tension and immersion.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains themes of crime and murder, but no direct depictions of extreme violence. Some scenes may feature blood or brief flashbacks related to past events. The overall atmosphere is dark and suspenseful, with psychological thriller elements.
